proof_body:
by
  intro t
  have h := Complex.Gamma_mul_Gamma_one_sub (1 / 2 + t * Complex.I)
  have hc : (1:ℂ) - (1 / 2 + t * Complex.I) = (starRingEnd ℂ) (1 / 2 + t * Complex.I) := by
    apply Complex.ext <;> simp <;> norm_num
  rw [hc, Complex.Gamma_conj, Complex.mul_conj] at h
  have hs : Complex.sin ((Real.pi:ℂ) * (1 / 2 + t * Complex.I)) = ((Real.cosh (Real.pi * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    rw [show (Real.pi:ℂ) * (1 / 2 + t * Complex.I) = ((Real.pi * t : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I + Real.pi / 2 by push_cast; ring, Complex.sin_add_pi_div_two, Complex.cos_mul_I]
    push_cast; rfl
  rw [hs] at h
  exact_mod_cast h
target_source: ∀ t : ℝ, Complex.normSq (Complex.Gamma (1 / 2 + t * Complex.I)) = Real.pi / Real.cosh (Real.pi * t)
